name: io.github.verygoodplugins/mcp-pirsch
title: MCP Pirsch
description: Pirsch Analytics with natural language queries and trend analysis

tools.name: pirsch_list_domains
tools.description: List safe summaries of Pirsch domains available to the configured read-only client

tools.name: pirsch_query_statistics
tools.description: Read one documented Pirsch Analytics API v1 metric for an explicitly selected domain and filter

tools.name: pirsch_list_filter_options
tools.description: List supported values for one documented Pirsch Analytics API v1 filter dimension

tools.name: pirsch_compare_periods
tools.description: Compare Pirsch totals and visitor series for a named or explicitly supplied pair of periods
